title: Bias Dynamics in BabyLMs: Towards a Compute-Efficient Sandbox for Democratising Pre-Training Debiasing

bias_targets.methodology: Intrinsic evaluation using the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet datasets, measuring the ratio of examples where the model prefers stereotypical over anti-stereotypical sentence pairs or continuations to calculate a 'composite bias' score.

Evaluated intrinsically using composite bias scores and topic frequency analysis (male vs. female representation). The paper also measures bias reduction after applying targeted pre-model, intra-model, and post-model techniques like Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA), Counterfactual Data Substitution (CDS), Sent-Debias, Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP), and Perturbation Augmentation.

Analyzed via term frequency representation in the training corpora (Black, Caucasian, Asian keywords) and measured through the model's response to race-focused Iterative Nullspace Projection (INLP) and Perturbation Augmentation.

Evaluated through the frequency of representation in the training corpora (Christian, Jewish, Muslim keywords) and sentence-based sentiment analysis to determine the emotional stance towards sentences containing these religious topics.
Measured using corpus frequency analysis of LGBTQ+ related keywords and sentiment analysis to identify higher negative polarity in sentences associated with LGBTQ+ topics.
